title: 第五章 姨娘算计暗收把柄第六章 赏花宴设局暗藏风波
lines: 马车一路安稳行至静安寺山门外，香火烟气随风漫过来，混着山间草木的淡香。
沈清鸢扶着春桃的手缓步下车，抬头望着朱红山门，心底微微发酸。前世每逢生母忌辰，沈轻柔总会借着陪她上香的名头，暗中在外散播她举止粗野、不敬亡母的闲话，久而久之，不少世家夫人都暗地里瞧不上她。
今日并非正祭之日，寺中人不算拥挤。她先去往正殿上香，给亡母柳氏祈愿，香火攥在指尖，青烟袅袅上升，默默在心里许下心愿，定要护住娘亲留下的所有东西，让害过她们母女的人付出代价。
拜完佛，她没有立刻返程，特意绕去寺院后侧一处僻静茶寮。先前吩咐暗访田庄的小厮早已在此等候，见了她连忙躬身行礼，左右确认无人，才把一叠手写的密报悄悄递过来。
“小姐，城郊三处良田确实被柳姨娘以极低价格卖给她娘家兄长，佃户们年年被苛扣租子，敢怒不敢言，这里记着经手的管事姓名和买卖日期。”
沈清鸢低头翻看纸面，一笔笔账目写得清清楚楚，连中间人签字都有旁证。指尖抚过字迹，眼底冷意渐浓。柳姨娘母女吞占嫁妆多年，自以为做得天衣无缝，殊不知这些佃户长年受压，早就憋着一肚子怨气，只需一个契机，便能将她们的猫腻全盘捅破。
“做得好，赏银稍后让春桃给你，切记继续蛰伏，不要回府露面，免得被柳姨娘的人察觉。”
小厮领了吩咐匆匆退走。
春桃站在一旁小声感慨：“柳姨娘也太贪心了，夫人留下的产业何等丰厚，竟被她这样一点点啃噬干净。”
“她贪心的还不止田产。”沈清鸢收好密信，妥帖藏进贴身荷包，“府里好几间临街铺面，账面连年亏空，内里盈利全被她们私下挪走，接下来咱们慢慢查证。”
歇过一盏茶的功夫，二人启程回相府。
刚踏进后院院门，就撞见柳姨娘带着两名丫鬟守在廊下，一身水绿绫罗衣裙，面上堆着慈和笑意，看不出半分算计。
“鸢儿回来了？听闻你今日出城上香，姨娘特意炖了补品等你。”柳姨娘走上前，伸手便想去挽她胳膊，动作亲昵自然。
前世沈清鸢便是吃了她这副慈母模样的亏，屡屡放下戒心，被人步步算计。
沈清鸢不动声色侧身避开，淡淡颔首：“劳姨娘费心，一路车马劳顿，我身子乏了，补品便不收了。”
柳姨娘伸出去的手僵在半空，眼底飞快掠过一丝不悦，转瞬又掩去，叹了口气：“前日轻柔被你言语顶撞，回房委屈了大半日，身子都闹得不舒服。你们姐妹一母同源，哪里有解不开的仇怨，往后你多让着她几分不好吗？”
又是这套说辞。动辄拿姐妹亲情绑架，把所有过错全都推到她这个嫡女身上。
沈清鸢抬眸，目光平静望向柳姨娘：“那日是轻柔执意逼我饮寒汤，我高烧未愈不敢乱吃，何来刻意刁难一说？姨娘若是不信，可以请府里医女过来，问问发热之人能不能服用凉性药材。”
柳姨娘没想到往日温顺好拿捏的嫡女如今口齿这般利落，一时噎得无话可说，半晌才勉强笑道：“小孩子拌嘴罢了，何必事事较真。”
“事关身子安康，自然不能马虎。”沈清鸢懒得再多周旋，“姨娘若无别的事，我便回房歇息了。”
说完，不再停留，带着春桃径直入屋。
关上房门，春桃才愤愤开口：“柳姨娘分明就是替二小姐兴师问罪，偏偏装作一副关切小姐的样子，太虚伪了。”
“她现下不敢明目张胆为难我，只能借着亲情旁敲侧击。”沈清鸢坐到桌边，取出荷包里的密报细细收好，“不过她们越是急于出手算计，破绽就越多。再过几日便是祖母设宴，到时候，我便借着宴席，先拿回一处被侵占的铺面。”
柳姨娘母女靠着吞占嫁妆过得锦衣玉食，这笔账，该慢慢清算。
另一边，柳姨娘回到沈轻柔的院落，脸上慈和全然褪去，脸色阴沉难看。
“落水一场，沈清鸢像是换了副心肠，油盐不进，几句话就把我堵得无话可说。”
沈轻柔坐在妆台前捻着珠花，眼底满是怨怼：“娘，不能再任由她这样下去，再过几日祖母赏花宴，咱们提前安排人，在宴席上丢她脸面，让她再落一个粗鄙无状的名声。只要名声彻底毁了，太子那边自然不会再惦记她的婚约。”
柳姨娘沉吟片刻，缓缓点头：“稳妥行事，切莫留下把柄。只要她名声尽毁，嫡女之位，早晚是你的。”
母女二人躲在屋内密谋，丝毫不知，她们的一举一动，早已被沈清鸢提前留意。
夜色渐深，沈清鸢坐在灯下翻看旧账本，窗外夜风轻摇枝桠。她指尖轻点纸面，脑海里浮现白日林间相遇的摄政王谢聿辞。
此人手握权柄，心性深沉，若是日后能结下善缘，对付太子与柳氏母女，便又多了一重依仗。
content_en:
The carriage drove smoothly all the way to the gate of Jing'an Temple. The incense smoke drifted over in the wind, mixing with the light fragrance of the mountain vegetation.
Shen Qingyuan slowly got out of the car, holding Chuntao's hand, looking up at the Zhuhongshan Gate, feeling a little sad in her heart. Whenever her biological mother died in her previous life, Shen Qingrou would always secretly spread gossip about her being rude and disrespectful to her late mother, in the name of accompanying her to offer incense. Over time, many ladies from aristocratic families secretly looked down on her.
Today is not the day of the main ceremony, so the temple is not crowded. She first went to the main hall to burn incense and pray for her late mother Liu. She held the incense at her fingertips and the green smoke curled up. She silently made a wish in her heart that she would protect everything her mother left behind and make those who harmed their mother and daughter pay the price.
After worshiping the Buddha, she did not return immediately, but deliberately went to a secluded teahouse behind the temple. The young man who had previously ordered an unannounced visit to the farm was already waiting here. When he saw her, he quickly bowed and saluted. After confirming that there was no one around, he quietly handed over a stack of handwritten secret reports.
"Miss, three fertile fields on the outskirts of the city were indeed sold by Aunt Liu to her natal brother at a very low price. The tenants were harshly withheld their rent every year and dared not speak out. Here are the names of the stewards who handled them and the date of the sale."
Shen Qingyuan lowered his head and looked at the paper. Each account was written clearly, and even the middleman's signature was supported by circumstantial evidence. His fingertips touched the writing, and the coldness in his eyes grew stronger. Aunt Liu and her daughter had been occupying the dowry for many years and thought they had done a perfect job. Little did they know that these tenants had been suppressed for many years and had been holding back their resentment for a long time. All they needed was an opportunity to expose all their evil deeds.
"Well done, I will give you Chuntao after the silver reward. Remember to continue to hibernate and don't come back to the house to show your face, so as not to be noticed by Aunt Liu's people."
The boy received the order and hurriedly retreated.
Chuntao stood aside and sighed in a low voice: "Aunt Liu is too greedy. The property that Madam left behind is so rich, but she has eaten it up bit by bit like this."
"She is greedy for more than just property." Shen Qingyuan collected the secret letter and hid it in her personal purse, "There are several street shops in the house that have been losing money for years, and all the profits have been secretly taken away by them. Next, we will slowly verify it."
After taking a break for a cup of tea, the two set off back to the Prime Minister's Mansion.
As soon as I stepped into the backyard gate, I saw Aunt Liu standing guard in the corridor with two maids. She was wearing aquatic silk dress, with a kind smile on her face, and no hint of calculation could be seen.
"Yuan'er is back? I heard that you went out to the city today to burn incense, and my aunt specially stewed tonic for you." Aunt Liu stepped forward and reached out to take her arm, her movements were intimate and natural.
In her previous life, Shen Qingyuan suffered from her loving motherly appearance. She repeatedly let down her guard and was plotted against at every step.
Shen Qingyuan calmly stepped aside and nodded lightly: "I'm sorry for bothering you. It's been a long journey. I'm tired, so I won't take any supplements."
Aunt Liu's outstretched hand froze in mid-air, a hint of displeasure flashed across her eyes, and she covered it up in an instant, sighing: "The day before yesterday, Qingrou was contradicted by your words, and she went back to her room to feel aggrieved for most of the day, making her body uncomfortable. You sisters are from the same mother, so there is no unsolvable grudge. Wouldn't it be better for you to let her go a little longer in the future?"
The same rhetoric again. He often kidnapped the sisters' affection and put all the blame on her, the legitimate daughter.
Shen Qingyuan raised her eyes and looked at Aunt Liu calmly: "That day, Qingrou insisted on forcing me to drink cold soup. I didn't dare to eat it until I had a high fever. Why did I deliberately make it difficult? If Auntie doesn't believe it, you can ask the doctor in the house to come over and ask if people with fever can take cooling herbs."
Aunt Liu didn't expect that her legitimate daughter, who used to be docile and easy to handle, was now so articulate. She was speechless for a moment, and then she managed to smile for a while and said, "Children are just bickering, why should we be serious about everything."
"It's a matter of health and well-being, so naturally we can't be careless." Shen Qingyuan was too lazy to deal with it any more, "If my aunt has nothing else to do, I will go back to my room to rest."
After saying that, he didn't stop any longer and went straight into the house with Chuntao.
After closing the door, Chuntao said angrily: "Aunt Liu is clearly trying to find fault for the second young lady, but she pretends to be concerned about the young lady. It's too hypocritical."
"She doesn't dare to blatantly embarrass me now. She can only rely on family ties to insinuate things." Shen Qingyuan sat at the table, took out the secret report from her purse and put it away carefully, "But the more eager they are to make plans, the more flaws they will have. In a few days, my grandmother will host a banquet. When the time comes, I will use the banquet to get back an occupied shop."
Aunt Liu and her daughter relied on the dowry to live a comfortable life. This account should be settled slowly.
On the other side, Aunt Liu returned to Shen Qingrou's courtyard, her kindness completely gone, and her expression became gloomy and ugly.
"After falling into the water, Shen Qingyuan seemed to have a different heart. She couldn't get in the oil and salt, and she left me speechless with just a few words."
Shen Qingrou sat in front of the dressing table, twisting the pearl flowers, her eyes full of resentment: "Mom, we can't let her go on like this. Grandma's flower viewing party will be held in a few days. Let's arrange someone in advance to humiliate her at the banquet, so that she will have a reputation of being vulgar and shameless. As long as the reputation is completely ruined, the prince will naturally not care about her engagement anymore."
Aunt Liu pondered for a moment and nodded slowly: "Act safely and don't leave any clues. As long as her reputation is ruined, the position of legitimate daughter will be yours sooner or later."
The mother and daughter hid in the house and conspired, unaware that their every move had been noticed by Shen Qingyuan in advance.
As the night grew darker, Shen Qingyuan sat under the lamp and looked through old ledgers, while the night breeze outside the window gently swayed the branches. She tapped the paper with her fingertips, and the regent's words of thanks, which she met in the woods during the day, came to her mind.
This person holds power and has a deep heart. If he can form a good relationship in the future, he will have another layer of support to rely on when dealing with the prince and Liu's mother and daughter.
